$schema_note: This is the FULL validation-engine constraint set, checked against a finalized design by mission.check_constraints() -- broader than optimization/constraints.json, which only lists the subset actively enforced INSIDE the NSGA-II search loop (n_constr=2). Every row here should appear in the final validation table (report Section 6.4 / Table 4). Keep 'enforced_during_search' accurate: it's what distinguishes an in-loop constraint from a post-hoc check.

constraints.label: Payload ≥ 200 kg
constraints.notes: Currently fixed as a constant in aircraft.py rather than a free variable, so it's trivially always satisfied -- not actively enforced as an inequality.

constraints.label: Battery SoC ≥ 0.20 throughout mission
constraints.source: Li-ion cell chemistry -- protects against over-discharge/voltage sag
constraints.known_violation: RL-adaptive fallback controller violates this at the current chosen design point (min SoC 0.178) -- see report Table 4 and Section 6.3-6.4.

constraints.label: Battery SoC ≤ 0.90 throughout mission
constraints.source: Li-ion cell chemistry -- protects against high-SoC lithium plating risk

constraints.label: Required cruise power ≤ engine rating × 1.15 (hybrid-assist margin)
constraints.notes: This is the constraint that surfaces the report's Section 5 finding: at PS1's 250 km/h, required power (~59 kW) sits right at the edge of the 60 kW engine rating with almost no margin.

constraints.label: Endurance ≥ 6.0 hr (baseline target)
constraints.source: GARUN internal target, derived from PS1 mission intent

constraints.label: Endurance ≥ 7.7 hr (RL-improvement target)
constraints.source: Originally submitted proposal figure -- reference target, not independently re-derived by this codebase (see optimization/objectives.json :: reference_target_for_knee_selection)

constraints.label: Static margin within 5-15% MAC
constraints.source: Standard fixed-wing UAV stability requirement (see report Part 11.3 CG/AC discussion)
constraints.notes: Currently only estimated by hand in the conceptual layout section (CG at 1.43m, AC needs to sit ~1.55-1.60m from nose for ~8% margin). Not yet a code-enforced check -- requires wing-position as an explicit design variable first.

source: mission.py :: CONSTRAINTS and check_constraints(); optimization/constraints.json; report Part 11.3
